title: Sidney The Pink Dinosaur Show
description: Before his sci-fi career, Sidney the dinosaur hosted a kids show that featured educational songs, life lessons, and all-around fun.
quote: Good is better than bad. Happy’s better than sad. My advice is just be nice ’cause good is better than bad.
altHero: Sidney, a pink dinosaur wearing tuxedo top and boater hat, dancing on a set decorated with big alphabet blocks
